1.text: “Manuka wicare mu mukungugu, wa mwari w'i Babuloni we. Wa mukobwa w'Abakaludaya we, icara hasi ukuwe ku ntebe y'ubwami, kuko utazongera kuvugwaho ko udamaraye kandi ko umenyereye kugubwa neza.

2.text: Enda ingasire usye, utwikurure mu maso hawe, kuba igishura cyawe ucebure, wambuke imigezi.

3.text: Ubwambure bwawe buzatwikururwa, ni koko isoni zawe zizagaragara. Nzahōra inzigo ne kubabarira n'umwe.”

4.text: Umucunguzi wacu izina rye ni Uwiteka Nyiringabo, Uwera wa Isirayeli.

5.text: “Wa mukobwa w'Abakaludaya we, icara uceceke ujye mu mwijima, kuko utazongera kwitwa umugabekazi w'abami.

6.text: Narakariye ubwoko bwanjye, nsuzugura gakondo yanjye ndabakugabiza, ntiwabababarira na hato abasaza ubashyira ku gahato gakomeye cyane.

7.text: Uravuga uti ‘Nzaba umugabekazi iteka ryose.’ Ibyo ntiwabyitayeho kandi ntiwibuka iherezo ryabyo.

8.text: “Nuko rero umva ibi yewe uwihaye kwinezeza, ukicara udabagira, ukibwira mu mutima uti ‘Ni jye uriho nta wundi, sinzaba umupfakazi kandi sinzapfusha abana.’

9.text: Ariko ibyo gupfusha abana no gupfakara byombi bizakugeraho umunsi umwe bigutunguye, uburozi bwawe nubwo ari bwinshi bute, n'ibikagiro byawe nubwo ari byinshi cyane, bizakugeraho byimazeyo

10.text: kuko wiringiye ubugome bwawe ukavuga uti ‘Nta wundeba.’ Ubwenge bwawe n'ubuhanga bwawe ni byo bikuyobeje uribwira uti ‘Ni jye uriho nta wundi.’

11.text: “Ni cyo kizatuma ibyago bikugeraho ntumenye irasukiro ryabyo, ishyano rizakugwira ntuzashobora kuryikuraho, kandi kurimbuka utari wamenya kuzagutungura.

12.text: Nuko komeza ibikagiro byawe n'uburozi bwawe uko bingana, ibyo wahirimbaniye uhereye mu buto bwawe ahari aho bizagira icyo bikuvura, ahari bizatuma unesha.

13.text: Inama zawe nyinshi zirakuruhije, abaraguza ijuru n'abaraguza inyenyeri n'abahanura ukwezi kubonetse bakavuga ibizaba, nibahaguruke bagukize ibizakuzaho.

14.text: “Dore bazamera nk'ibishingwe umuriro ubatwike, ntibazikiza imbaraga z'ibirimi byawo. Uwo muriro ntuzaba amakara yo kotwa, cyangwa icyotero cyo kwicarwa iruhande.

15.text: Uko ni ko ibyo wahirimbaniye bizakubera, abaguranaga nawe uhereye mu buto bwawe bazigendera umuntu wese yigira ahe, nta wuzaba uhari wo kugukiza.
